messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH error-rate for service="inference-gateway" in region=us-west2. 5xx rate up ~9x over 3m. PD incident: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/P123456 — auto-page to @oncall-alex

pagerduty: P123456 created and paging rotation started. No manual ack within 2m — will escalate if still unacked.

Alex (oncall): On it, grabbing context. Any obvious customer impact?

Jen (sre): Seeing lots of 502/504 from ingress-proxy -> backend timeouts. Spike began ~12:10 UTC. Related graph: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ingress/5xx-rate?orgId=1&from=now-15m

Alex (oncall): Copy. Running quick mitigation: shifting traffic away from the new slice. Executing:```bash
./infra/ops shift-route --service inference-gateway --from canary-usw2 --to warm-pool-usw2 --percent 80
```

incident-bot: Route-shift command accepted, started at 12:13:22 UTC. PagerDuty: auto-escalation triggered (unacked >3m) — paging next rotation: Dan (infra).

Dan (infra): Taking over. I will check LB health and node egress. @Jen can you paste the most recent ingress logs?

Jen (sre): Logs (truncated):```
[12:11:03] ingress-proxy us-west2 - GET /api/generate - 502 - backend_conn_reset
[12:11:14] ingress-proxy us-west2 - POST /v1/chat - 504 - upstream_timeout
[12:11:45] ingress-proxy us-west2 - GET /health - 200 - 0.01s
[12:12:18] ingress-proxy us-west2 - POST /v1/generate - 502 - backend_latency=2.9s
```
Pattern: spikes concentrated on a subset of frontends, backend latency climbs to ~3s then resets.

Sean (eng): fyi I shipped a change to the retry logic yesterday that touched the client backoff for that route (PR #987). Reverting now in case it's interacting badly with the warm-pool routing: `git revert 3f8b2c4` -> deploying.

Maya (cs): Heads-up — CS has two inbound tickets reporting degraded responses from west users (CS-7890, CS-7891). Customers see slow/failed generations but no data corruption. Updating them: "We're investigating and mitigating; will follow up."

Alex (oncall): Traffic shifted ~75% away from canary, metrics show 5xx down from 9x -> ~1.6x baseline. Still some intermittent 504s. Keeping PD incident open. Monitoring for 20m before ~hand-off to next oncall.

pagerduty: P123456 acknowledged by Dan (infra) at 12:15:40 UTC. Escalation suppressed.

Dan (infra): Found one overloaded proxy pod hitting connection-table limits, restarted that replica:```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n inference --selector=region=us-west2
```Restarting controller now, watching health endpoints.

incident-bot: Restart completed at 12:18:02 UTC. 5xx spike decayed; 5xx-rate trending back to baseline over last 3m. No further new CS tickets in the last 10m.

Alex (oncall): Nice. Customer impact: degraded latency for some west customers, no request loss. Action items: Jen to own postmortem, Sean to validate retry-change, Dan to add probe to detect connection-table saturation. Will keep incident open until 30m quiet. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Jen (sre): Will draft postmortem and link runbook refs: /runbooks/inference/5xx-spike and include mitigation timeline.

Alex (oncall): If no regression by 12:43 UTC I'll close the PD incident. Otherwise Dan please escalate.
